Faithful youthful Japanese 2D anime identity, long natural LIGHT BROWN hair, softly curved side locks and gently curled ends, fine airy bangs, clear BLUE eyes and a delicate youthful observant face. Her hair is light brown rather than blonde, gray, pink or Sakiko's blue. BOTH eyes and their fine linework remain clear and visible; bangs frame the eyes naturally instead of hiding either eye. Hair top near y110 and shoe soles near y875 belong to this source; no body relocation, head enlargement, new gesture or new leg pose. Cushion weight and local shoe-floor contacts remain believable at these same positions. Do not use any B-wave or rejected drifting mother as input.

Whole-scene light instruction: Match the approved OVERCAST-DAY empty plate: gray clouded daytime sky, soft cool diffuse window daylight, gentle warm local porcelain/desk lamp contribution, restrained contrast with NO hard solar grid or direct-sun highlights. The room remains plainly daytime. Repaint the figure's face, hair, white shirt/collar, navy/gray blazer, paper, socks/shoes and all local contacts for this same diffuse light. Do not leave apricot-sunlit hair/skin on a cloudy room. Preserve natural own colors, not a blue filter.

Retain refined youthful 2D anime linework and naturally modeled shading integrated with the detailed literary-room illustration. No recasting, mature model styling, new body, cropped feet, gray/gold overlay, extra spotlight, halo, neon, UI, captions, readable book text, logo, watermark, collage, borders or artificial foreground fog.
